recommendation: DO NOT PUBLISH. `pending` stays true. Read the review.
review: NOT A GAMING MERCHANT, AND HELD FOR THE SAME REASON POWOXI WAS. 224 products and the type list reads: 13S 54.6V CHARGER, 48V GOLF CHARGER, RV CHARGER, 4S LIFEPO4 BMS, 30S 126V CHARGER. These are e-bike, golf-cart and RV battery chargers and battery management boards. Nothing here plugs into a desk, a handheld or a console.

This is the single largest capture of the thirteen, so holding it is the most expensive judgement in this batch and it is made anyway. POWOXI's 32 deer-feeder solar chargers were held on 2026-08-29; publishing ohrija's 224 would be the same shelf with more of it, and the only difference is the size of the number.
The Power room's blurb is 'chargers, cables, and the brick you keep losing'. A 126V lithium pack charger is not that brick.
REGISTRY PLATFORM WAS WRONG here too: it said shopify, the Woo Store API answered. Corrected in the same commit so that if this is ever published the strategy is right.
One word from the owner publishes it. The capture is understood and the file is here so nobody reads it twice.
